prompt.intro: You are helping a parent build a Sanskrit practice test for their child (roughly 5th-grade level, learning Sanskrit as a second language).
prompt.matchRule: Match the vocabulary, grammar forms, phrasing style, and difficulty of the existing items below exactly. Do not introduce vocabulary or grammar patterns that aren't already present in this section, and do not repeat any of the stems shown below.
prompt.subPatternExamples: different pronoun pairs, different grammatical persons, or different named word/option sets
prompt.distractorHint: other words from the same category, other grammatical forms of the same root — not random unrelated words

hint.noTest: No test has been published yet.
